description: Directed knowledge graph of kinship relations in the Alyawarra language group of Australia. 25 relation types (kinship terms) connect 104 persons. Each person pair has exactly one kinship relation, making this a simple directed graph (not a multigraph). Edge attributes are the relation types.
name: Kinship Knowledge Graph
